issues: The kitchen counter and appliances are tightly packed against the left wall, leaving little usable preparation space.
The sofa occupies much of the narrow living area, with circulation squeezed between it and the kitchen.
The sleeping area has a bed but little separation from the rest of the studio and limited bedside space.
The rooms have plain gray walls and minimal industrial detailing, so the requested industrial style is only weakly expressed.
The views show no clear dining or work surface, and the space feels sparsely furnished for a complete studio.
ai.summary: The plan includes a compact kitchen, sofa and sleeping area, but tight circulation and sparse industrial character keep it below a professional standard.

issues: The plan shows a large bedroom-like room and a bathroom, but no identifiable small kitchen or sofa.
The bed sits in an otherwise mostly empty room with little separation from the rest of the studio.
Large expanses of empty floor leave the requested living and cooking areas undefined.
The flat gray finishes and simple furnishings do not establish a convincing industrial style.
No light fixtures are visible in the room views.
The visible bedroom door and bathroom access appear awkwardly positioned near the bed and provide limited clear circulation.
old.summary: The render shows a sparse bedroom and bathroom, while the requested kitchen, sofa, and coherent industrial studio layout are missing.
